obligations.text: A cause of action in the nature of defamation, invasion of privacy, or negligence shall not arise against any person for disclosing personal or privileged information in accordance with this chapter, or against any person for furnishing personal or privileged information to a licensee, surplus line insurer, reinsurer, or third-party service provider.
